locality.embedding: Actual TextModel L41/L64: replicated BF16 table, IndexSelect dim0; no TP collective. Gather 341 rows by file offsets/get_slice and remap IDs to compact table, then same IndexSelect. This is a proposed fixture extraction, not already implemented.
locality.input_norm: Actual Decoder L17/18: RmsNorm BF16 output with ones and cfg eps=1e-5, then BF16 Mul input_layernorm.weight. No fused replacement.
locality.prepare: Actual AttentionPrepare(tp_size=8,tp_rank=0) with same Runtime and original FP8 provider; replicated qA/kvA, rank0-row-sharded qB/kvB plus whole original scales. No TP collective in prepare. TP1 invalid for comparison because it produces64 heads rather than8.
locality.hidden_state: Layer0 is first layer on first PP stage; no prior decoder/PP input. RoPE table owner and FP8 caches initialized exactly by same constructors/policies; reset before cohort cases.
locality.full_indexer_boundary: Actual selector forward L44 DOES TP allreduce scores; unchanged NativeAttentionProjectedR22 cannot run TP8 on one GPU. No learned selection replay claimed. At 512 keys, selected=min(2048,512)=512, so Topk returns all key IDs including masked futures; actual old selection_map+sparse_impl drops future/dedups/sorts. Canonical full key set therefore gives same causal membership for this bounded attention-only fixture, not historical raw selection order.

weight_budget.full_qB_kvB_source_used: Prefer existing full-source ModelWeights::load_parameters_no_sync then native rank slicing; source64.4MB is small. Avoid inventing new presliced weight-loading API to save42MB.

minimal_bridge.generate: CPU compact embedding rows -> same native IndexSelect -> exact input norm -> prepare.forward_latent -> prepare.expand_cached once per4096-token cohort; hold normalized input, prepared query/latent/rotary and fresh K/V until all cases drained.
minimal_bridge.baseline: Actual717 sparse_attention_mapped_bounded with mode2, original selection_map_r302 full512 membership, positions, past0 and scale1/16. Per request headbatch8, QK/PV M1 causal prefix. Run one arm reading fresh K/V views and one reading resident-style bank slot after real D2D append; byte-readback equality before timed replay isolates append/alias. This reuses actual old attention callee, not a hand-written near-reference.

minimal_bridge.cache: One fixed640-capacity resident pair with16slots, per-slot contiguous[640,8,256] and512-prefix; hold banks plus views to shared completion. Test two cohorts sequentially, do not clear another cohort. No hostbank substitute labeled actual479;479 had resident[38,40].
minimal_bridge.cleanup: Same owner/device/eager/capture/pointer validation before enqueue; poison/drain after mutating enqueue failure; completed stream before releasing borrowed parents; clear actual FP8 Runtime caches and shared RoPE according to existing close provider; normal close/post-KFD via reviewed controller. No illegal GPUfault cases.

capacity.interpretation: 352MiB is only dots/df/scaled/rounded/logits/prob/pb sum; prepared tensors, packed copies, output, RoPE and allocator/provider workspace additional. Not a peak proof. Retain original6GiB free admission/512MiB floor; bounded single layer far below full78layer image.
